items.name: LR2 product tanker time charter-out agreements
items.claim: Scorpio Tankers entered agreements to time charter-out two LR2 product tankers, STI Gladiator and STI Jermyn, each for a three-year term at $40,188/day and $42,500/day respectively, commencing September 2026.
items.source_excerpt: The Company has recently entered into agreements to time charter-out two LR2 product tankers, STI Gladiator and STI Jermyn , and one MR product tanker, STI Pontiac . The agreements for STI Gladiator and STI Jermyn are each for a term of three years at rates of $40,188 per day and $42,500 per day, respectively. These time charters are expected to commence in September 2026.

notes: September 2026 TCE/time-charter update names three vessel charter-out agreements; excerpted the two LR2 contracts with explicit dated day-rates.
